answer_2.quote: We evaluate the topic quality in terms of both topic diversity and topic coherence: Topic Diversity (TU) measures the uniqueness of the words across all topics; Normalized Pointwise Mutual Information (NPMI) measures topic coherence internally using a sliding window to count word co-occurrence patterns; Topic Coherence (C V ) is a variant of NPMI that uses the one-set segmentation to count word co-occurrences and the cosine similarity as the similarity measure.
